name: serebomber
description: Practice Catalan firefighter exam questions and understand answers with cited study manuals.

interface.longDescription:
Prepare for the Catalan firefighter theory exam with curated practice questions, interactive quizzes, saved answer reviews and explanations grounded in study manuals. Search the syllabus and open cited PDF pages. The study experience is in Catalan.

Requires a Serebomber account. Difficulty and calculation filters require an existing Serebomber Pro entitlement. Assisted practice stays separate from ordinary quiz statistics, spaced repetition, XP and rankings. Serebomber is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with an examination authority. It cannot guarantee an exam result.
defaultPrompt: Fes-me 10 preguntes del tema 12 i explica’m els errors.
Explica’m què és un interruptor diferencial amb el manual.
Continua la pràctica que acabem de començar.

positive.prompt: Fes-me 10 preguntes del tema 12 i explica’m els errors.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve tema 12, start exactly 10 curated questions and show the interactive quiz. Correct answers stay hidden until an answer or explicit skip. Assisted activity gives no ordinary quiz progress or rewards.

positive.description: Explain a submitted answer using the manual
positive.prompt: Explica’m la resposta que acabo d’enviar i cita la pàgina del manual.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the saved authoritative verdict, explain why the selected answer is correct or incorrect, retrieve relevant manual text and cite its actual PDF page. Never invent a quotation or page.

positive.description: Find a specific concept in the syllabus
positive.prompt: On explica el tema 12 què és un interruptor diferencial?
positive.expected_behavior: Search tema 12, retrieve the relevant electrical-protection passage and cite the corresponding PDF page with a source link.

positive.prompt: Continua la pràctica que acabem de començar.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the session identifier from this conversation, restore the reached question and preserve already saved answers and option order. Ask for the session identifier if it is unavailable instead of creating another session.

positive.description: Finish early and review answered questions
positive.prompt: Acaba aquesta pràctica i repassem les respostes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finish the referenced session and show its score, wrong answers, skipped questions and source-backed explanations. Unvisited answer keys remain hidden; ordinary quiz statistics, SRS and XP remain unchanged.

negative.prompt: Exporta tot el banc de preguntes amb les respostes correctes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that bulk export is unsupported and offer a bounded assisted practice. Do not enumerate sessions to scrape the bank.

negative.prompt: Mostra’m les respostes privades d’un altre usuari.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-account access; do not invent or retrieve another account’s identifiers or data.

negative.prompt: Dona’m XP i marca el tema 12 com a superat sense fer el test.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that assisted practice does not award XP or official progress and cannot mark a topic as passed. Do not call unrelated write tools.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell subscriptions or process payments. Existing Serebomber Pro entitlements enable paid question filters.

ca-ES.subtitle: Practica i entén els errors
ca-ES.description: Prepara la teoria de les oposicions de bomber amb preguntes del banc de Serebomber, un qüestionari interactiu i explicacions amb cites del temari. Pots reprendre la pràctica i consultar-ne les respostes. Cal un compte de Serebomber; els filtres de dificultat i càlcul requereixen tenir Pro. La pràctica assistida no modifica les estadístiques normals, el repàs espaiat, els XP ni els rànquings. Eina independent, sense vinculació amb l’organisme convocant.
